title: AdaAlloc: Adaptive Visual Token Allocation for Long-Video Question Answering
title_zh: AdaAlloc：面向长视频问答的自适应视觉token分配

paragraphs.en: 提出免训练的AdaAlloc框架，在长视频问答中自适应分配视觉token，较均匀采样最高提升10.5个百分点。 Long-video question answering forces multimodal large language models to reason under strict visual-token budgets, creating a tradeoff between broad temporal coverage and fine-grained spatial detail. Uniform sampling preserves coverage but often obscures decisive local cues, while caption-based or frame-similarity retrieval operates over lossy proxies that can miss motion, state changes, and before-after relations. We recast long-video reasoning as a visual-token allocation problem: given a fixed budget, decide how much to spend on global context versus high-resolution local evidence, and where in the video to draw that local evidence from. We introduce AdaAlloc, a training-free inference framework that adaptively allocates visual tokens between a global video overview and localized visual detail. AdaAlloc first plans a global/local allocation policy, then uses temporal grounding to locate candidate evidence segments and refines them into a compact temporal memory. The selected policy controls both frame sampling density and resolution, combining sparse, lower-resolution global frames with denser, higher-resolution local frames drawn from the refined memory. The final answerer reasons over the allocated global context and refined local evidence. Across LVBench, MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench, AdaAlloc improves over budget-matched uniform sampling by up to 10.5 percentage points and outperforms the compared frame-selection and agentic methods on their reported benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 提出免训练的AdaAlloc框架，在长视频问答中自适应分配视觉token，较均匀采样最高提升10.5个百分点。长视频问答迫使多模态大语言模型在严格的视觉token预算下进行推理，从而在广泛的时间覆盖与细粒度空间细节之间产生权衡。 均匀采样能保持覆盖面，但常常掩盖决定性的局部线索；而基于字幕或帧相似度的检索则在有损的代理信息上运作，可能遗漏运动、状态变化以及前后关系。 我们将长视频推理重新表述为一个视觉token分配问题：在给定固定预算的情况下，决定在全局上下文与高分辨率局部证据上各花费多少，以及从视频中的哪个位置提取该局部证据。 我们提出AdaAlloc，这是一个免训练的推理框架，能够在全局视频概览与局部视觉细节之间自适应地分配视觉token。 AdaAlloc首先规划全局/局部分配策略，然后利用时间定位找到候选证据片段，并将其精炼为紧凑的时间记忆。 所选策略同时控制帧采样密度与分辨率，将稀疏、低分辨率的全局帧与从精炼记忆中提取的更密集、更高分辨率的局部帧相结合。 最终的回答器基于所分配的全局上下文与精炼后的局部证据进行推理。 在LVBench、MLVU、VideoMME和LongVideoBench上，AdaAlloc相比预算相同的均匀采样最高提升10.5个百分点，并在其所报告的基准上优于对比的帧选择方法与智能体方法。
